candidates.description: This feature vector represents psychological and psychiatric conditions, symptoms, and related mental health terms.
This vector represents pharmacological and chemical substances, including their concentrations, properties, and biological effects.
This feature vector represents terms related to degree, magnitude, and qualitative or quantitative change.
This vector represents psychoactive substances, recreational drugs, and related botanical products.
This feature vector represents the concept of utilization and the action of using something across multiple languages and grammatical forms.
This vector represents the concept of multiplicity, variety, and diverse quantities across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents the concept of quantifying indefinite plural amounts, corresponding to words meaning "some" or "several" across multiple languages.
The feature vector activates on terms, roots, and suffixes related to forensics, medicine, and legal or scientific analysis.
Adverbs and adverbial modifiers across multiple languages indicating manner, time, or emphasis.
This vector represents the concept of the root word "produce" and its various grammatical forms, inflections, and translations across multiple languages.
